title: Membership in the influential coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $\\tau\\in\\mathbb{R}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. Then $i$ is among the coordinates whose influence under $f$ is at least $\\tau$ if and only if $\\tau$ is at most the influence of $i$ under $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
